posts.raw_content:
As in many American families, mine has recently-deceased Boomers.  Others still living.  And other generations; interacting, in sometimes-stereotypical ways.

My extended family's internal 'politics' are calcified.  The grudges and unsolved problems are decades-old, unchanging.   Mostly-- I 'live and let live' with the family's Old Guard.  I don't butt heads or burn bridges.  

This resembles our Nation as a whole.   Political divides festering into Derangement Syndromes.   Unsolved issues like National Debt, Healthcare, Social Security solvency, Housing.  Boomers who will die without cutting those Gordian Knots.   And with a Joe Biden-like refusal to pass the sword to younger, stronger heirs.

I've never compared myself to a character in a Kevin Costner movie. Even typing those words seems nutty.    But-- for purposes of making a point-- my job is similar to Costner in 'Bull Durham'.   I'm a mid-career veteran.  I go to different companies & jobsites.  The smart owners realize I can turn their hapless young hires into high performers-- and delegate me the power to shape them.  But, right now, I'm inside one company owned by an 88 year old with Parkinson's-- and one owned by an 82 year old with failing kidneys.   Both have a DEATH GRIP on their companies.  Refusing to retire, or make plans for the companies to survive when they die.  Neither one trusts me to hone their staff into capable heirs.   As in my own family, I'm inclined to defer to the status quo, rather than butt heads.  

But the GRIM REAPER is doing the HEAD BUTTING and BUTT KICKING, bigtime.    Kidney Failure has degenerated into a whiner.  His eyes lit up when someone brought-in fancy gourmet cookies.  But he is so habituated to petty complaining-- that he struggled to find fault with it.  "Does this contain gluten?"   His wife: "You aren't allergic to gluten."     He sends out emails & leaves voicemails-- with completely-imaginary accusatory jabs-- to his own manufacturing supply chain.  Then is baffled that they've stopped answering him.  So a self-created shortage  of raw materials threatens to halt his company's production.  Our customers are calling, worried about the delays affecting their business-- seeking alternate suppliers.

Parkinsons has different problems.   An old girlfriend from the 1960's has re-appeared.  She literally looks & talks like Hillary Clinton.   She has wormed her way into the role of managing the trust which will control the business when he dies.   She has partnered with a fussy ass-kisser.  Straight guy who acts gay & convinces Parkinsons that he's "writing about" the old man's greatness & "legacy"-- as an excuse to pat-down his pockets/ snoop in accounts/ measure the old man for a coffin.  Except there's also a tough little prune of a longtime-employee who sees everything & she is talking to Parkinson's (also ancient) lawyer-- about forensic accounting, forged signatures, and elder abuse.  Maybe she'll succeed.  I'll help.

"Thank God it's Friday."   I crashed asleep right after dinner.  Awoke at midnight with mental clarity:

There's not much I can do about my stubborn blood relatives in their last days.   Or about the entire geriatric Nation.   Which is precisely-why I'm so attuned to the dysfunction in the companies I serve.  And why I try to steer them away from ruin.  Because that's one realm where I can do-so.

When I started writing this-- I thought I'd draw more comparisons between the State of The American Union-- and family & work.    But I think I've said enough.
